name: Joshi Ana 2
source:
Makoto is a TV producer. He really loves female newscasters and has slept with a lot of them. His target newscasters now are Jun and Teruko. He decides to use them as newscasters of a news program he is in charge of. Jun and Teruko are happy to hear that, but they don't know what will happen to them yet.... Yes, they are sexually assaulted by Makoto during the TV program. They are afraid of him and talk to Yuri, their senior, about it. But Yuri is already Makoto's sex slave, so Yuri tells Jun and Teruko just to endure it. They heed her advice and continue appearing the program. Like this, they are gradually addicted to his techniques....

[From ErogeShop]
